Actor Maniesh Paul's Mother Passes Away at 77

Actor and host Maniesh Paul's mother, Urmil Paul, passed away at the age of 77. The actor's team confirmed the news. Paul shared an emotional post on social media bidding farewell to his mother, stating, 'Today World Feels Quieter.' Several celebrities, including Varun Dhawan, Ayushmann Khurrana, and Mouni Roy, offered their condolences.
